features.note: Compose sheet with To, Subject and Message

features.feature: Cc, Bcc and Reply-To address fields
features.note: Fields shown from View menu toggles; Bcc kept out of headers (message.rs Draft::render). The choice is saved in mail-prefs.json and comes back on the next run. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Check on Midget that the saved choice is applied at start

features.note: Threading headers kept
Message > Reply All and a Reply All button on the toolbar while a message is open. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Hide the toolbar button when the message has no other recipients, and check it on Midget

features.apple: Message > Forward, Forward as Attachment, Redirect
features.note: Forward quotes the text under Fwd:. Forward as Attachment sends the original as a message/rfc822 file. Redirect sends the original unchanged with Resent headers (message.rs redirect_message). Plain Forward does not re-attach the original's own files. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Re-attach the files of the original on a plain Forward

features.feature: Rich text formatting (bold/italic/underline, fonts, colours, alignment, lists, indentation)
features.note: Format menu: Bold, Italic, Underline, Text Color, Bulleted List and the indents apply to the text typed after them. The compose field draws the styles; a styled message is sent as a text/html alternative (message.rs Draft::render, richtext.rs html_body). Fonts, sizes and alignment are not done. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Add a selection to the compose field so formatting can apply to text already typed, plus fonts, sizes and paragraph alignment

features.note: Message > Attach Files and the sheet's Attach button open the SDK open panel (several files). The files are listed on the compose sheet with Remove buttons and sent as multipart/mixed (message.rs file_part); at most 8 files and 20 MB. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Accept files dropped on the compose sheet and show picture attachments inline in the message

features.note: Message > Save Attachments opens a save panel for each file in turn, and a tap on a file name in the reader saves that file alone. Without the panel the file goes into the app data directory. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Save every file into one folder chosen with a single panel

features.feature: Open or preview an attachment from the message
features.note: The files of the open message are listed one to a line in the reader and are tap targets (draw.rs attach_rects); a tap opens the save panel for that file. There is no in-app preview and no open-file service for apps yet. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Open the saved file in its default app once the SDK has an open-file service for apps, and preview pictures and text in a sheet

features.note: Prints plain text

features.feature: Export as PDF, Save As message
features.apple: File > Export as PDF, Save As
features.note: File > Save As writes the raw .eml where the save panel chooses. Export as PDF is not done. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Render the message to PDF through the print path into a save panel

features.note: Message > Flag Color (seven colours, Clear Flag) stored as the $MailFlagBit0-2 keywords; the list row shows a colour dot. Not on the toolbar; no flag-colour smart filter yet.
features.wire: Map the colours to the $MailFlagBit0-2 keywords in flags.rs, add a submenu in window.rs and a colour dot to the list row in draw.rs

features.note: Unread dot in the list, draw.rs:397

features.feature: Move To / Copy To mailbox, Move Again
features.apple: Message > Move to, Copy to, Move Again
features.note: The Move menu holds Move To, Copy To (the first 22 mailboxes of the account) and Move Again. Dragging rows onto the sidebar is not done. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Drag rows onto sidebar mailboxes, and a picker sheet for accounts with more than 22 mailboxes

features.feature: Move to Junk and junk filtering
features.apple: Message > Move to Junk; Junk settings
features.note: Move to Junk marks the message $Junk and moves it to the account Junk mailbox; moving a message out of Junk sets $NotJunk instead. Automatic junk filtering of new mail is not done. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Filter new mail by the $Junk marks the user has set

features.apple: Message > Remind Me; View > Sort by Send Later
features.note: Message > Remind Me asks when, and the message comes back unread with a notification. Message > Send Later adds a Send in field to the compose sheet. Both use the queue in mail-queue.json that tick() runs. Follow-up (a reminder when a sent message gets no reply) is not done. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Remind when a sent message gets no reply

features.note: Message > Mute / Unmute keeps the conversation key in muted.txt, silences its new-mail notifications, and the list marks muted conversations with a Muted tag. Ignore follow-up is not done. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Ignore follow-up: stop reminders for a conversation

features.note: Priority menu on the compose sheet sends X-Priority and Importance.
features.wire: Mark High and Low priority messages in the list, and check the headers on Midget

features.note: Message > Remove Attachments cuts the file parts out (mime.rs strip_attachments), appends the result under the same flags and deletes the original over IMAP (session.rs append and remove). Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Replace the file with a short note in the text, and check it against more servers

features.note: Message > Add Sender to Contacts asks the contacts service whether the address is known and saves the sender's name and address if not (people.rs). Needs the contacts access the person grants in Settings. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Offer the other recipients, and open the card afterwards

features.note: Mailbox > Rules: New Rule (sender, recipient and subject contain; move to a mailbox, mark read, flag in a colour), Delete Rule and Apply Rules. Rules run on mail that arrives in an inbox and on request over the shown mailbox. They live in mail-prefs.json (rules.rs). A message a rule moves or reads raises no notification. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: A Rules settings pane that lists the rules for editing, more criteria (any or all, other headers, dates) and more actions (delete, forward, reply, sound)

features.apple: View > Organize by Conversation, Expand/Collapse All Conversations
features.note: View menu items and a disclosure triangle in the first row of a conversation fold and unfold it. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Check the triangle target on Midget

features.feature: Sort messages by field and order
features.note: View > Sort By: Date Received, From, To, Subject, Flag and Read Status, ascending or descending. Size is not done. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Read RFC822.SIZE in the listing and add Size and Attachments keys

features.feature: Filter the message list (unread, flagged, attachments)
features.note: View > Filter: All, Unread, Flagged, Replied and With Attachments (judged by the message type until its text is loaded). No toolbar button yet. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: A filter button on the toolbar

features.note: Local and server search with field syntax

Edit > Find in Message opens a find bar over the reader (draw.rs draw_find_bar): typed text is searched in the drawn lines, every match is highlighted, Return and Find Next / Find Previous step through them and scroll to the match. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Replace; match whole words; find in the raw source view

features.feature: Hide or show sidebar and toolbar, column layout, side preview
features.apple: View > Show Sidebar, Use Column Layout
features.note: View > Hide Sidebar and View > Hide Toolbar. Column layout and the side preview are not done. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Column layout and side preview toggles that feed layout::panes (layout.rs:11)

features.note: Mailbox > Add to Favorites Bar pins the shown mailbox; View > Show Favorites Bar shows a strip of chips under the toolbar. The pins are saved in mail-prefs.json. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Drag mailboxes onto the bar and reorder the chips; show an unread count on each

features.note: Mailbox menu items and a name sheet; IMAP CREATE, RENAME, DELETE.
features.wire: Offer the existing mailboxes as parents when creating one, and check the server delimiter on Midget

features.note: Mailbox > New Smart Mailbox saves a search under a name; it is listed in the sidebar and applies its search to the shown mailbox (Query::matches locally, UID SEARCH on the server). Mailbox > Delete Smart Mailbox removes the one on screen. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Search every mailbox of the account at once, and edit a smart mailbox

features.note: Refresh plus the IDLE watcher in sync.rs:158

features.apple: Mailbox > Erase Deleted Items, Erase Junk Mail
features.note: Mailbox > Erase Deleted Items and Erase Junk Mail.
features.wire: Erase for every account at once, and check on Midget

features.note: Mailbox > Export Mailbox reads the newest 5000 messages of the shown mailbox and writes an mbox file (mboxrd) to the place the save panel chooses. Mailbox > Import Mailbox reads an mbox file and appends its messages to a mailbox named after the file, created when missing. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Import a whole folder of mbox files, keep the read state of imported messages, and export a selection

features.note: Manual IMAP/SMTP setup; password kept in Passwords

Mailbox > Account Settings opens the setup form filled with the shown account (name, address, servers, ports); saving updates the shared account list and the password in Passwords. Mailbox > Remove Account asks for the name, removes the account from the list and its password from Passwords. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: A pane that lists all accounts, test the servers before saving, and edit the other services of an account

features.apple: EditEmailAliases; Composing > Send new messages from
features.note: Mail Settings keeps other addresses for each account; the compose sheet then has a From field that a click cycles through the account address and its aliases. The choice must be one of them. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Pick the alias a message was addressed to when replying

features.note: Mail Settings keeps a signature for each account; the compose sheet shows it under the text and adds it after a "-- " line when the message is sent (also in the HTML part). Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Several signatures for an account, with a choice in the compose sheet

features.feature: Viewing settings (headers shown, remote content, bold unread, dark backgrounds)
features.note: sanitize can block remote images, but there is no settings pane and messages are shown as text
features.wire: Add a Viewing settings pane and wire html::sanitize and HTML rendering into the view

features.feature: Composing settings (format, quoting, undo send delay, spelling)
features.note: Mail Settings sets an undo-send delay of 0 to 30 seconds: the message waits in the outbox and Message > Undo Send brings it back as it was written. Spelling is Edit > Check Spelling. Message format and quoting settings are not done. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Settings for quoting the original in replies, plain text only, and spelling as you type

features.note: Uses system type by design
HTML is turned into plain text
features.wire: Render the sanitized HTML (html.rs:37) through the SDK web or rich text view

features.apple: View > Message > All Headers, Raw Source; RawSourceWindow
features.note: View > Raw Source (Opt+Cmd+U) shows the whole message text in the reader. A separate window and a headers-only mode (All Headers) are not done.
features.wire: Add a raw source window over the fetched raw text in the body cache

features.note: Mailbox > Show Activity lists what Mail did lately (reads, changes, sends, new mail, with times). Mailbox > Check Connection signs in to the incoming and the outgoing server of the shown account and reports each answer (sync.rs diagnose). It is a sheet, not a live panel. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: A live Activity panel with progress and a stop button, and a doctor that also checks certificates and ports

features.feature: Paste as Quotation, Paste and Match Style
features.note: Edit > Paste as Quotation. A plain paste takes the style of the text typed so far, which is what Paste and Match Style does. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Check on Midget; a Paste and Match Style command by name

features.note: Edit > Check Spelling sends the message to the system text service and underlines the misspelled words in the compose field; Next Misspelling steps through them and shows suggestions; Correct Spelling replaces the word in view and checks again. Text substitutions, grammar and speech are not done. Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Check as you type, text substitutions from Keyboard settings, and speech

features.note: View > Category shows Primary, Transactions, Updates or Promotions only. A message is classified from its headers (List-Unsubscribe, List-Id, Precedence, Auto-Submitted, the sender's address and the subject). Built on parity/team-d-mail; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Show the category of each message in the list and let the user move a message to another category
